runs.text: The first
is reached: "cierro la puerta" goes onto the stack.
The second one is reached: "apago la luz" sits on top.
When the block ends the top one comes off first, "apago la luz", and then "cierro la puerta".
Only what is
reached
counts: a
in a branch not taken notes nothing. Inside a loop, every round notes its own cleanups and runs them when that round ends:

blocks.title: Cleanups per round
blocks.source:
Algoritmo Vueltas
  Para i <- 1 Hasta 3 Hacer
    Diferir
      Escribir "fin de la vuelta ", i;
    FinDiferir
    Si i = 2 Entonces
      Salir;
    FinSi
    Escribir "vuelta ", i;
  FinPara
FinAlgoritmo

entries.text: If the program fails with a trap, it ends at once
computes its result before the cleanups: a cleanup cannot hide the value or the error being returned.

blocks.title: Exit inside a cleanup
blocks.source:
Algoritmo LimpiezaMala
  Para i <- 1 Hasta 2 Hacer
    Diferir
      Salir;
    FinDiferir
  FinPara
FinAlgoritmo
